answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique leak detector alert history. It rests on alerts answered at one home across three years, which gives every honest agent a delta that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. What makes this stick is that alerts answered at one home across three years cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the anchor of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The defender's bill stays flat — one quick verification per account — while the attacker's bill climbs with every clone, and the shale is that asymmetry in plain numbers.
